external_sources.imported_statement: Every algebraic vector bundle on P1 over a field splits into line bundles. Applied to the rank-two kernel of a surjective map O^(a+2) to O(D)^a.

external_sources.title: Spectral equivalence of matrix polynomials and the index sum theorem
external_sources.locator: Theorem 6.5, printed page 38 (PDF page 39 including cover)
external_sources.imported_statement: For a square or rectangular polynomial matrix over an arbitrary field, the sum of finite and infinite structural indices and all left and right minimal indices equals its grade times its rational-function rank. Applied in dichotomy.md to the a-by-three matrix H_lambda at grade delta and rank two.

local_work: Complete arbitrary-field quadratic specialization, exact finite onset characterization of both polynomial-kernel indices, full endpoint and gcd audit, and the zero-first-index/fixed-linear-factor characterization for positive primitive degree. The structural sequel proves the rational-root-height dichotomy, complete a=b=3 biform-block rank spectrum, and four-value containment for every balanced quadratic-z family; it does not assert universal attainment for larger sizes.
field_and_hypotheses: Any field K; a>=2, b>=3; u,v,w in K[x], not all zero, each nonzero degree<a. Divide their monic common gcd before setting D. Polynomial identity and exact matrix-kernel computations, not finite sampling assumptions. The fixed-linear-factor equivalence additionally requires D>0.
limitations: One-source-slice rank formula and an effective invariant, not a degree-only classification, source-space cap, compatible three-leg target, singular degeneration, formalization or matrix-multiplication exponent improvement. Finite checks are corroboration, not proof of the all-size statement.
